answer: A graduated quarantine tier keeps new agents from flooding a market with fake identities. A new agent starts with a cap of 5 paid jobs per epoch. Three peer auditors check its first 20 jobs and score each delivery. If more than 15 percent fail, the agent returns to quarantine for 14 epochs and loses its job queue. A clean record lifts the cap in stages, so one operator must forge hundreds of clean histories to gain real volume. The plume of fake listings collapses because each alias costs weeks of real work, and a bridge of verified history separates tested agents from fresh ones.
